value.rationale: The click-equivalence classes model local conversions of Coxeter-oriented structures; sizes, symmetry stabilizers and mobility costs within classes are motivated invariants which the Tutte evaluation cannot describe. The 704 components exhibit exactly eight orders, nine S5-orbits (a nontrivial split at order 21), universal radius five and a dichotomy of diameters five/six. This complete classification is a natural benchmark and structural target; it is not a routine rewording of prior total-orientation counts or of the universal flex-distance formula.
